description: Under the corrugate, out of the sun, in the shade of the cart itself. The Clinkerman's whole trade is spread on boards within arm's reach of where he sits: sorted, graded and priced by a system he has never written down. The bell rope runs past his shoulder. He does not stop talking, and he does not stop listening to the flats either.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it is doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
